jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Remote Sensing Specialists; Data Scientists; PhysicistsStellenbeschreibung:Earth Observation (EO) & Remote Sensing Engineer (m/f/d) Location: Germany (Hybrid / Remote options available)  Contract Type: Full-Time Employment (Permanent)  Target Group: Remote Sensing Specialists, Data Scientists, Physicists, Opportunity Card Holders, and Master's Graduates  About Project IRIS Project IRIS develops AI-supported spatial resilience and geospatial data models for the energy transition.
